transitions.text:
# Readable process source; authority is selected explicitly by the build manifest.
# The migration is gated by author.run correspondence and publication validation.
process-module "temple/surface-process-module/1"
profile "encounter/module-batch/microsites/1"

process microsites.preview:
  each subjects("isa", "PublicationAsset") as msAsset:
    when or(
      includes(one($msAsset, "path"), "temple/"),
      includes(one($msAsset, "path"), "sourcery/")
    ):
      port file.copy { path = one($msAsset, "path") } → _
  call microsites.project

process microsites.build:
  assert eq(one("microsites.release", "status"), "qualified")
    otherwise "Microsite fidelity qualification is incomplete. Use the local preview manifest; do not publish this as the faithful replacement."
  call microsites.project

process microsites.project:
  call microsite.return.styles
  each subjects("isa", "MicrositeStylesheet") as msSheet:
    let input = one($msSheet, "root")
    call source.css
    port file.write { path = one($msSheet, "path"); text = $result } → _
  each subjects("isa", "MicrositeDocument") as msDocument:
    let input = one($msDocument, "root")
    call source.markup
    call microsite.return.project
    port file.write { path = one($msDocument, "path"); text = $result } → _
  each subjects("isa", "Microsite") as msSite:
    port json.parse { text = one($msSite, "configuration") } → msConfiguration
    port runtime.bundle {
      entry = "microsite.boot";
      mode = "browser";
      grantProfile = "micrositesBrowser";
      queries = objects($msSite, "runtimeQuery");
      factSubjects = list();
      data = { site = one($msSite, "name"); configuration = $msConfiguration };
      budget = 20000000
    } → msRuntime
    port file.write { path = concat(one($msSite, "name"), "/runtime.js"); text = $msRuntime } → _
  port runtime.bundle {
    entry = "microsite.early";
    mode = "browser";
    grantProfile = "micrositesEarly";
    queries = list("microsite.early");
    factSubjects = list();
    budget = 20000000
  } → msEarly
  port file.write { path = "temple/early.js"; text = $msEarly } → _

process microsite.early:
  port dom.classToggle { selector = "html"; name = "js"; value = true } → _

process microsite.boot:
  port state.set { key = "configuration"; value = $data.configuration } → _
  port browser.select { selector = "#spell-form" } → spell
  when not(eq(count($spell), 0)):
    port kernel.invoke { query = "ui.sourcery.init"; input = {  } } → _
  when eq($data.site, "sourcery"):
    port kernel.invoke { query = "motion.sourcery.init"; input = {  } } → _
  port browser.select { selector = "#composer" } → composer
  when not(eq(count($composer), 0)):
    port kernel.invoke { query = "ui.temple.init"; input = {  } } → _
  when eq($data.site, "temple"):
    port kernel.invoke { query = "motion.temple.init"; input = {  } } → _
    port kernel.invoke { query = "media.screens.init"; input = {  } } → _
